name: audit-log
title: Audit log
description: Who changed what and when: every create, update and delete with a field-level diff (private fields never recorded). Admin API included.
author: CalmAPI
docs:
Every resource write is recorded automatically. Read it: GET /api/audit-log?resource=post&recordId=<id> (admins only).
Exclude a resource with `audit: false` in its resource() options.
